summary: Error message 'Invalid Signature' when attempting to e-sign Agreement
description: Sales Agent reports that configured fees and services for a new merchant are not saving upon submission, leading to incorrect pricing in the agreement.
resolution: A backend synchronization issue was identified and resolved by initiating a manual sync process. Sales Agent confirmed that the fees and services configurations were now accurately displayed.
